findings.title: Light-theme color changed from 30% to 70% lightness for embedded post meta-data link
findings.body: The original rule was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The replacement is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`, so on light themes the color shifts from a 30%-lightened $primary to a 70%-lightened $primary, making the bold poster-name link in expanded embedded posts much fainter than before. The dark arm (30% of $secondary) is the correct dark-theme counterpart of the original 30%; the light arm should have stayed 30%.

findings.title: custom-message-length light-theme color darkened from 70% to 30% lightness
findings.body: Original: `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`. New: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The light-theme arm was changed to 30% lightness instead of keeping 70% and adding 70% of $secondary as the dark arm, so on light themes the flag-modal custom-message character counter renders much darker than intended. Compare with the desktop modal.scss change for the same class, which correctly kept 70% in the light arm.

findings.title: group-member-info .name light-theme color changed from 30% to 50% lightness
findings.body: Original: `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. New: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme arm should have remained 30% (with the dark arm derived from $secondary); instead the name in the group member list becomes noticeably lighter on light themes, inconsistent with the neighboring .title which was correctly left at its original 50%.

findings.title: group-member-info .name light-theme color changed from 30% to 50% lightness
findings.body: Same issue as the desktop user.scss change: the original `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` became `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, altering the light-theme rendering (30% -> 50% lightness) instead of only adding a dark-theme alternative.

findings.title: topic-map h3 light-theme color changed from 20% to 50% lightness
findings.body: Original: `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`. New: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme arm jumped from 20% to 50% lightness, so topic-map headings on mobile light themes are much fainter than before; the light arm should have stayed 20% (matching the `.number, i` rule changed a few lines below, which correctly kept 20%).
